item.title: Hunting Down a Go Runtime Bug on 32-bit Embedded Systems
item.description: A customer's Go application kept crashing on a 32-bit embedded Linux system. We traced the fatal netpoll error to a pointer aliasing bug in the Go runtime. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: An interactive introduction to the spanning tree protocol
item.description: Root election, port roles, proposals and agreements, topology changes: explore RSTP through simulations powered by MSTPD compiled to WebAssembly. (1 source: lobsters)
